sys_ux_event.description: Fired when Export is clicked (fires for every export mode, so you can also handle it yourself). With mode "csv" the component downloads a CSV; "serverList" opens the ServiceNow list export; "event" does nothing else. Payload: { tableName, query, columns, selectedSysIds, mode }.
sys_ux_event.label: Export clicked
sys_ux_event.props: [ { "description": "The list table.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Table name", "name": "tableName", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "The current query.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Query", "name": "query", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Visible column fields.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Columns", "name": "columns", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Currently selected sys_ids.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Selected sys_ids", "name": "selectedSysIds", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "The export mode: csv | serverList | event.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Mode", "name": "mode", "valueType": "string" } ]
